title: King Conan #4 Marvel Comics December 1980 Conan vs Thoth-Amon John Buscema
conditionDescription: Small chip and crease at the top right corner (close-up pictured); spine wear; back cover toned with light spotting. See photos.
descriptionText:
King Conan #4 (December 1980), Marvel Comics. "Conan vs. Thoth-Amon - to the death!" Written by Roy Thomas, art by John Buscema and Ernie Chan, John Buscema cover. 75c cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Series ad.

Condition: small chip and crease at the top right corner (close-up pictured), spine wear, back cover toned with light spotting. See photos.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
